Title: Syed‑Tajdar/ProductionAISystems

Production AI automation includes a call‑center QA agent, a bilingual Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) system integrated with a Multi‑Channel Processor (MCP), and n8n‑driven lead automation. The workflow comprises eight lightweight automations, each equipped with unit tests, performance evaluations, and live demonstration environments. The architecture is designed for scalable, OSINT‑oriented deployment while maintaining measurable uncertainty on model outputs.

signals.title: @aprajitanefes: 🇮🇷🇧🇭|Bahrain: The Satellite Imagery Is Out. The AR-327 Radar at Jabal Ad-Dukhan Is Gone. The Fifth Fleet Is Blind at the Head. The IRGC Aero
signals.content: 🇮🇷🇧🇭|Bahrain: The Satellite Imagery Is Out. The AR-327 Radar at Jabal Ad-Dukhan Is Gone. The Fifth Fleet Is Blind at the Head. The IRGC Aerospace Force announced the strike on Friday, 13 November 2026. The target was the US early-warning radar on Bahrain Island. The retaliation was for the US air attack on a telecommunications tower in Sirik, Hormozgan Province two days earlier. The satellite imagery released by Iranian media shows the before and after. The radar is the AR-327 long-range air surveillance radar at Jabal Ad-Dukhan. It is the sensor that feeds the air picture for the US Navy's Fifth Fleet, headquartered at Naval Support Activity Bahrain in Manama. The Radar That Was Destroyed The AR-327 is a three-coordinate, long-range air surveillance radar. It is not a point-defence radar. It is the wide-area sensor that detects aircraft and missiles at extended range and feeds the track data to the Fifth Fleet's command centre and the Patriot batteries on the island. The AP analysis of the satellite imagery confirmed damage to the protective structures and infrastructure linked to US radars in Bahrain, but the agency did not conclusively establish that the specific system identified by Iran had been completely destroyed. The Iranian media presented the imagery as the proof of the kill. The IRGC called the strike a "serious warning" to stop the "aerial provocations and oil smuggling in the Strait of Hormuz" and stated that if the violations recur, the IRGC Aerospace Force stands in full readiness to engage without limits. The Fifth Fleet's Blind Spot The Fifth Fleet is the US naval command for the Middle East. Its headquarters at NSA Bahrain is the main command centre for US naval operations in the region. The radar at Jabal Ad-Dukhan was the long-range eye for that headquarters. It detected threats before they reached the fleet. Without that radar, the Fifth Fleet's air picture is degraded. The Patriot batteries on the island lose their cueing data. The Aegis destroyers in port lose their early track. The Pentagon inspector general's report released in September 2026 found that Iranian attacks damaged or destroyed hundreds of buildings at US installations in eight countries, including Bahrain, in the first four months of the war. Analysts stated that several US bases in the region have been almost rendered unusable. The radar at Jabal Ad-Dukhan was already damaged in the June 2026 strikes. The 13 November strike finished the job. The Sirik Pretext The US struck a telecommunications tower in Sirik, Hormozgan Province, on Thursday, 12 November. The IRGC stated the tower was a civilian communications node. The US described the target as having a "military nature". The IRGC's response was proportionate in category, disproportionate in value. A telecommunications tower on the Iranian coast is a communications relay. The AR-327 radar at Jabal Ad-Dukhan is the early-warning sensor for the Fifth Fleet. The exchange was not symmetrical. The radar is the more valuable target. The Rate of the Campaign The 13 November strike is the first Iranian-claimed attack on US military assets inside a Gulf country since early September. The rate of the campaign slowed. The target set did not. The radar was destroyed. The message is that the IRGC can reach the Fifth Fleet's sensor whenever it chooses. The Bill The target: the AR-327 long-range air surveillance radar at Jabal Ad-Dukhan, Bahrain. The strike: IRGC Aerospace Force, Friday 13 November 2026, in retaliation for the US attack on the telecommunications tower in Sirik, Hormozgan Province. The proof: satellite imagery released by Iranian media, showing before and after the strike. The AP analysis: confirmed damage to protective structures and infrastructure linked to US radars in Bahrain; did not conclusively establish complete destruction. The US and Bahraini response: no immediate comment from Washington or Manama. The Pentagon inspector general's finding: Iranian attacks damaged or destroyed hundreds of buildings at US installations in eight countries, including Bahrain, in the first four months of the war. The context: the radar was already damaged in the June 2026 strikes. The radar at Jabal Ad-Dukhan is gone. The Fifth Fleet is blind at the head. The AR-327 is the receipt.

signals.title: psewar/skirnir
signals.content: Skirnir: a self-hosted LLM router and AI gateway for Ollama, with OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility, GPU-aware routing, cloud fallback, and optional shared agent memory.
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance; large language model relevance. Final score: 68. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: psewar/skirnir
Brief: Skirnir is a self‑hosted LLM router and AI gateway built for Ollama. It offers API compatibility with OpenAI and Anthropic, GPU‑aware request routing, optional cloud fallback, and a shared agent memory feature. The platform is designed for on‑premise deployment, allowing organizations to retain data control while integrating multiple LLM providers. Performance and cost depend on local hardware and the chosen fallback services; exact throughput figures are not publicly disclosed.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: psewar/skirnir
الملخص: Skirnir هو موجه نماذج لغة كبير (LLM) وبوابة ذكاء اصطناعي مستضافة ذاتيًا ومصمم للعمل مع Ollama. يدعم توافق واجهات برمجة التطبيقات مع OpenAI وAnthropic، ويوفر توجيهًا واعيًا لاستخدام وحدات معالجة الرسوميات (GPU)، وخيارًا للعودة إلى السحابة عند الحاجة، بالإضافة إلى ذاكرة مشتركة للوكيل. يهدف إلى تمكين المؤسسات من تشغيل نماذجهم محليًا مع الحفاظ على سيطرة البيانات، بينما يتيح دمج مزودي LLM المتعددين. تعتمد الأداء والتكلفة على البنية التحتية المحلية وخدمات السحابة المختارة؛ ولا تتوفر أرقام دقيقة للإنتاجية في المصادر العامة.

signals.brief_en: AgentDesk by Shraddhameduri is an open-source AI support agent framework built on FastAPI and React/TypeScript. The repository incorporates function-calling capabilities, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, and human-in-the-loop approval workflows. It also provides an offline evaluation suite to assess agent performance prior to deployment.
